---
name: We're evaluating / using OAAF
about: Voluntarily identify yourself as an adopter (entirely optional)
labels: adopter
---

Listing is optional — adopting OAAF needs no announcement and no permission. File this only
if you _want_ to be counted. See [ADOPTERS.md](../../ADOPTERS.md) for how entries are
verified, and [docs/adoption-signals.md](../../docs/adoption-signals.md) for the no-telemetry
policy.

**Who you are**

Organization or individual, and (optionally) a public link. A reachable identity is what lets
the entry be independently verified.

**What you are building with OAAF**

The MCP server, A2A agent, gateway, PDP integration, or other system where OAAF verifies
delegated authority.

**Stage**

Evaluating · Integrating · In production · Other.

**May we list you in ADOPTERS.md?**

Yes / not yet. We will not add you until you say yes _and_ the declaration is verified.

**Anything OAAF makes hard**

Optional — friction, gaps, or an interoperability need. (For a concrete "OAAF can't express
X" request, the interoperability template fits better.)
